item.title: We live in the middle of nowhere in Marion County and rarely use public goods. Why are our property taxes going up?
item.description: "I read the piece about property taxes, we live in the south forest area, about one hour from Ocala. We have 3.4 acres in the middle of nowhere. We take trash eight miles each direction and my only child is 30, yet property taxes went up $1,000 this year and will go up another $1,000 in 2026. item.title: Ruth Emilie Howard
item.description: Ruth Howard was generous, kind, and loved by all who met her. She had a wonderful sense of humor, love of family, and enjoyed many Ocala restaurants. Read more: Ruth Emilie Howard

item.title: Carol June Lindsey
item.description: Carol Lindsey enjoyed traveling, reading, baking, sewing, needlepoint, gardening and spending every free moment at the beach. She volunteered extensively with the Scottish Rites. Read more: Carol June Lindsey

item.title: Ocala church collects supplies for Jamaican hurricane victims
item.description: An Ocala church successfully rallied the community to gather a truck-load of hygiene, clothing, and medical items to benefit families in Jamaica who are recovering from Hurricane Melissa. Read more: Ocala church collects supplies for Jamaican hurricane victims

item.title: Edwin Arnold Blair Sr.
item.description: Edwin Blair Sr. was a devoted husband, father, grandfather, and servant of God. Edwin loved to play the guitar and was rarely seen without it. Read more: Edwin Arnold Blair Sr.

item.title: We could use a Home Depot in east Ocala
item.description: "Please push for a Home Depot in the Silver Springs side of town. The Lowe's on State Road 40 is terrible and after driving to the one on SR 200, I don't think anyone wants to deal with that. The manager at Lowe's is arrogant and thinks nothing will affect his horrible store. I would bet a Home Depot near by would make him think twice and make a lot of contractors very happy. item.title: Ocala woman accused of pointing gun, pouring soda on gas station clerk
item.description: An Ocala woman is facing multiple felony charges after a dispute over a lighter purchase allegedly escalated into her dousing a gas station clerk with soda and pointing a loaded gun at another employee. Read more: Ocala woman accused of pointing gun, pouring soda on gas station clerk

item.title: Our Marion community’s roadway hasn’t been completely resurfaced in over 23 years
item.description: "I live 18 miles north of Ocala, in Citra. We have a road off County Road 318 (NE 10th Avenue) that has been patched every once in a while. In 23 years, not once has the road been completely resurfaced. We went from about 20 homes to approximately 75+ that use the area. The roadway is half sand, half blacktop, with patches and a bad drop from county to private roads. We have no street lights and we haul our trash to the dump on NE 19th Court.
